missing_evidence: Redis-side telemetry (latency, errors, saturation) to confirm the timeout originates at Redis rather than inventory's client
candidates.statement: Inventory's Redis dependency is timing out: inventory traces show an ERROR redis.reserve_inventory span at 1650ms, inventory logs record 9 redis_operation_timeout errors (status 504), and inventory metrics show 27 dependency_timeouts with p95 1080ms, while order/payment/gateway remain healthy.
candidates.uncertainty: No Redis-side metrics or logs available; cause of the Redis timeouts (saturation vs network) is unestablished.

report.explanation: Inventory is the only degraded service: its Redis calls error and time out (traces, logs, metrics), while gateway, order, and payment logs show 200/ok and order metrics show no dependency timeouts. This supports a bounded redis-timeout root cause at inventory's Redis dependency.
